items.title: Clarence Gabriel Interview
items.q: The first band I started to play, I used to travel around with Sam Morgan and them to play the other fellas plays all the time, called Johnny Deeb.

ctx.x: How old were you when you started on drums?

I was about... I was about... I was about around... 15, 16, like that when I played with him. I was back around the 20, 21. And how long did you stay with the drums? Well, I stayed with him for a good while. Then I started picking up the banjo and started learning how to read the banjo. I hadn't been playing piano since I was about 10. Oh, you had? Oh, you started on the piano? You started the piano first. I started the piano first, but still I never could read too good with the piano. So, I picked up the banjo.…
Is he much older than you?
